en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a church with multiple spires and a separate wooden bell tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing are gathered outside the church and along the path. Trees frame the scene. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Lerum. Kyrkan." and the publisher's imprint "Jac. Hægerströms förlag." appears at the lower right. There is handwritten vertical text in cursive along the right margin.
